brief: 5 skincare myths a board-certified specialist wants you to stop believing.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.subtitle: THE TRUTH BEHIND EVERYDAY BEAUTY LIES

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: THE REAL SCIENCE
slots.body: There is more misinformation online than ever. Let us separate fact from fiction so you can protect your skin barrier and invest wisely.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: NATURAL IS SAFER
slots.body: Poison ivy is natural, yet highly irritating. Many synthetic ingredients are clinically proven to be gentler and more effective than raw botanicals.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: CLOUDS BLOCK RAYS
slots.body: Up to 80 percent of UV rays pass through clouds. Daily broad-spectrum protection is essential regardless of the weather forecast.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: OILY SKIN NEEDS NOTHING
slots.body: Skipping moisturizer triggers rebound oil production. A lightweight, non-comedogenic hydrator balances sebum and strengthens your barrier over time.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: PORES OPEN AND CLOSE
slots.body: Pores are not muscles; they lack the ability to open or shut. Steam merely softens debris, while cold water only causes temporary constriction.

slots.author: Olivia Voss
slots.title: RESULTS COME OVERNIGHT
slots.body: Real change happens at the cellular level. Consistent use of proven actives like retinoids and peptides yields visible improvement after several weeks.
